audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Steadfast love, covenant, divine council, Davidic king, creation, military power, rejection, broken promise, and lament.

verses.restored: I will sing of the mercies of YHWH for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

familiar.text: I will sing of the mercies of the LORD for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

modern.text: I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.

original.text: מַ֝שְׂכִּ֗יל לְאֵיתָ֥ן הָֽאֶזְרָחִֽי חַֽסְדֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה עוֹלָ֣ם אָשִׁ֑ירָה לְדֹ֥ר וָדֹ֓ר אוֹדִ֖יעַ אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בְּפִֽי

verses.restored: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

familiar.text: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

modern.text: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”

original.text: כִּֽי אָמַ֗רְתִּי ע֭וֹלָם חֶ֣סֶד יִבָּנֶ֑ה שָׁמַ֓יִם תָּכִ֖ן אֱמוּנָתְךָ֣ בָהֶֽם

verses.restored: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn to David my servant,

familiar.text: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

modern.text: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:

original.text: כָּרַ֣תִּֽי בְ֭רִית לִבְחִירִ֑י נִ֝שְׁבַּ֗עְתִּי לְדָוִ֥ד עַבְדִּֽי

verses.restored: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

familiar.text: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

modern.text: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah

original.text: עַד ע֭וֹלָם אָכִ֣ין זַרְעֶ֑ךָ וּבָנִ֨יתִי לְדֹר וָד֖וֹר כִּסְאֲךָ֣ סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O YHWH: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

familiar.text: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O LORD: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

modern.text: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD— Your faithfulness as well— in the assembly of the holy ones.

original.text: וְי֘וֹד֤וּ שָׁמַ֣יִם פִּלְאֲךָ֣ יְהוָ֑ה אַף אֱ֝מֽוּנָתְךָ֗ בִּקְהַ֥ל קְדֹשִֽׁים

verses.restored: For who in the heaven can be compared to YHWH? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened to YHWH?

familiar.text: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the LORD? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the LORD?

modern.text: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?

original.text: כִּ֤י מִ֣י בַ֭שַּׁחַק יַעֲרֹ֣ךְ לַיהוָ֑ה יִדְמֶ֥ה לַ֝יהוָ֗ה בִּבְנֵ֥י אֵלִים

verses.restored: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

familiar.text: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

modern.text: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.

original.text: אֵ֣ל נַ֭עֲרָץ בְּסוֹד קְדֹשִׁ֣ים רַבָּ֑ה וְ֝נוֹרָ֗א עַל כָּל סְבִיבָֽיו

verses.restored: O YHWH God of hosts, who is a strong YHWH like to thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

familiar.text: O LORD God of hosts, who is a strong LORD like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

modern.text: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.

original.text: יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹ֘הֵ֤י צְבָא֗וֹת מִֽי כָֽמ֖וֹךָ חֲסִ֥ין יָ֑הּ וֶ֝אֱמֽוּנָתְךָ֗ סְבִיבוֹתֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

familiar.text: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

modern.text: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.

original.text: אַתָּ֣ה מ֭וֹשֵׁל בְּגֵא֣וּת הַיָּ֑ם בְּשׂ֥וֹא גַ֝לָּ֗יו אַתָּ֥ה תְשַׁבְּחֵֽם

verses.restored: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

familiar.text: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

modern.text: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.

original.text: אַתָּ֤ה דִכִּ֣אתָ כֶחָלָ֣ל רָ֑הַב בִּזְר֥וֹעַ עֻ֝זְּךָ֗ פִּזַּ֥רְתָּ אוֹיְבֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

familiar.text: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

modern.text: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.

original.text: לְךָ֣ שָׁ֭מַיִם אַף לְךָ֥ אָ֑רֶץ תֵּבֵ֥ל וּ֝מְלֹאָ֗הּ אַתָּ֥ה יְסַדְתָּֽם

verses.restored: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

familiar.text: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

modern.text: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.

original.text: צָפ֣וֹן וְ֭יָמִין אַתָּ֣ה בְרָאתָ֑ם תָּב֥וֹר וְ֝חֶרְמ֗וֹן בְּשִׁמְךָ֥ יְרַנֵּֽנוּ

verses.restored: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

familiar.text: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

modern.text: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.

original.text: לְךָ֣ זְ֭רוֹעַ עִם גְּבוּרָ֑ה תָּעֹ֥ז יָ֝דְךָ֗ תָּר֥וּם יְמִינֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

familiar.text: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

modern.text: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.

original.text: צֶ֣דֶק וּ֭מִשְׁפָּט מְכ֣וֹן כִּסְאֶ֑ךָ חֶ֥סֶד וֶ֝אֱמֶ֗ת יְֽקַדְּמ֥וּ פָנֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O YHWH, in the light of thy countenance.

familiar.text: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O LORD, in the light of thy countenance.

modern.text: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.

original.text: אַשְׁרֵ֣י הָ֭עָם יוֹדְעֵ֣י תְרוּעָ֑ה יְ֝הוָ֗ה בְּֽאוֹר פָּנֶ֥יךָ יְהַלֵּכֽוּן

verses.restored: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

familiar.text: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

modern.text: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.

original.text: בְּ֭שִׁמְךָ יְגִיל֣וּן כָּל הַיּ֑וֹם וּבְצִדְקָתְךָ֥ יָרֽוּמוּ

verses.restored: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

familiar.text: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

modern.text: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.

original.text: כִּֽי תִפְאֶ֣רֶת עֻזָּ֣מוֹ אָ֑תָּה וּ֝בִרְצֹנְךָ֗ תרים קַרְנֵֽנוּ

verses.restored: For YHWH is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

familiar.text: For the LORD is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

modern.text: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.

original.text: כִּ֣י לַֽ֭יהוָה מָֽגִנֵּ֑נוּ וְלִקְד֖וֹשׁ יִשְׂרָאֵ֣ל מַלְכֵּֽנוּ

verses.restored: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

familiar.text: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

modern.text: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.

original.text: אָ֤ז דִּבַּ֥רְתָּֽ בְחָ֡זוֹן לַֽחֲסִידֶ֗יךָ וַתֹּ֗אמֶר שִׁוִּ֣יתִי עֵ֭זֶר עַל גִּבּ֑וֹר הֲרִימ֖וֹתִי בָח֣וּר מֵעָֽם

verses.restored: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

familiar.text: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

modern.text: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.

original.text: מָ֭צָאתִי דָּוִ֣ד עַבְדִּ֑י בְּשֶׁ֖מֶן קָדְשִׁ֣י מְשַׁחְתִּֽיו

verses.restored: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

familiar.text: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

modern.text: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.

original.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר יָ֭דִי תִּכּ֣וֹן עִמּ֑וֹ אַף זְרוֹעִ֥י תְאַמְּצֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

familiar.text: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

modern.text: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.

original.text: לֹֽא יַשִּׁ֣א אוֹיֵ֣ב בּ֑וֹ וּבֶן עַ֝וְלָ֗ה לֹ֣א יְעַנֶּֽנּוּ

verses.restored: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

familiar.text: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

modern.text: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.

original.text: וְכַתּוֹתִ֣י מִפָּנָ֣יו צָרָ֑יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֥יו אֶגּֽוֹף

verses.restored: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

familiar.text: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

modern.text: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.

original.text: וֶֽאֶֽמוּנָתִ֣י וְחַסְדִּ֣י עִמּ֑וֹ וּ֝בִשְׁמִ֗י תָּר֥וּם קַרְנֽוֹ

verses.restored: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

familiar.text: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

modern.text: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.

original.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י בַיָּ֣ם יָד֑וֹ וּֽבַנְּהָר֥וֹת יְמִינֽוֹ

verses.restored: He shall cry to me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

familiar.text: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

modern.text: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’

original.text: ה֣וּא יִ֭קְרָאֵנִי אָ֣בִי אָ֑תָּה אֵ֝לִ֗י וְצ֣וּר יְשׁוּעָתִֽי

verses.restored: I will also make him firstborn, highest of the kings of the earth.

familiar.text: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

modern.text: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

original.text: אַף אָ֭נִי בְּכ֣וֹר אֶתְּנֵ֑הוּ עֶ֝לְי֗וֹן לְמַלְכֵי אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

familiar.text: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

modern.text: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.

original.text: לְ֭עוֹלָ֗ם אשמור ל֣וֹ חַסְדִּ֑י וּ֝בְרִיתִ֗י נֶאֱמֶ֥נֶת לֽוֹ

verses.restored: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

familiar.text: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

modern.text: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.

original.text: וְשַׂמְתִּ֣י לָעַ֣ד זַרְע֑וֹ וְ֝כִסְא֗וֹ כִּימֵ֥י שָׁמָֽיִם

verses.restored: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

familiar.text: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

modern.text: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,

original.text: אִם יַֽעַזְב֣וּ בָ֭נָיו תּוֹרָתִ֑י וּ֝בְמִשְׁפָּטַ֗י לֹ֣א יֵלֵכֽוּן

verses.restored: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

familiar.text: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

modern.text: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,

original.text: אִם חֻקֹּתַ֥י יְחַלֵּ֑לוּ וּ֝מִצְוֺתַ֗י לֹ֣א יִשְׁמֹֽרוּ

verses.restored: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

familiar.text: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

modern.text: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.

original.text: וּפָקַדְתִּ֣י בְשֵׁ֣בֶט פִּשְׁעָ֑ם וּבִנְגָעִ֥ים עֲוֺנָֽם

verses.restored: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

familiar.text: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

modern.text: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.

original.text: וְ֭חַסְדִּי לֹֽא אָפִ֣יר מֵֽעִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹֽא אֲ֝שַׁקֵּ֗ר בֶּאֱמוּנָתִֽי

verses.restored: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

familiar.text: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

modern.text: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.

original.text: לֹא אֲחַלֵּ֥ל בְּרִיתִ֑י וּמוֹצָ֥א שְׂ֝פָתַ֗י לֹ֣א אֲשַׁנֶּֽה

verses.restored: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie to David.

familiar.text: Once have I sworn by my holiness that I will not lie unto David.

modern.text: Once and for all I have sworn by My holiness— I will not lie to David—

original.text: אַ֭חַת נִשְׁבַּ֣עְתִּי בְקָדְשִׁ֑י אִֽם לְדָוִ֥ד אֲכַזֵּֽב

verses.restored: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

familiar.text: His seed shall endure for ever, and his throne as the sun before me.

modern.text: his offspring shall endure forever, and his throne before Me like the sun,

original.text: זַ֭רְעוֹ לְעוֹלָ֣ם יִהְיֶ֑ה וְכִסְא֖וֹ כַשֶּׁ֣מֶשׁ נֶגְדִּֽי

verses.restored: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

familiar.text: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

modern.text: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah

original.text: כְּ֭יָרֵחַ יִכּ֣וֹן עוֹלָ֑ם וְעֵ֥ד בַּ֝שַּׁ֗חַק נֶאֱמָ֥ן סֶֽלָה

verses.restored: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

familiar.text: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

notes.title: Covenant crisis
notes.body: The psalm boldly says the promised Davidic order appears rejected and broken. The contradiction between promise and experience is part of the text’s theology and should not be harmonized away.

modern.text: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.

original.text: וְאַתָּ֣ה זָ֭נַחְתָּ וַתִּמְאָ֑ס הִ֝תְעַבַּ֗רְתָּ עִם מְשִׁיחֶֽךָ

verses.restored: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

familiar.text: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

modern.text: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.

original.text: נֵ֭אַרְתָּה בְּרִ֣ית עַבְדֶּ֑ךָ חִלַּ֖לְתָּ לָאָ֣רֶץ נִזְרֽוֹ

verses.restored: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

familiar.text: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

modern.text: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.

original.text: פָּרַ֥צְתָּ כָל גְּדֵרֹתָ֑יו שַׂ֖מְתָּ מִבְצָרָ֣יו מְחִתָּה

verses.restored: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

familiar.text: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

modern.text: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.

original.text: שַׁ֭סֻּהוּ כָּל עֹ֣בְרֵי דָ֑רֶךְ הָיָ֥ה חֶ֝רְפָּ֗ה לִשְׁכֵנָֽיו

verses.restored: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

familiar.text: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

modern.text: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.

original.text: הֲ֭רִימוֹתָ יְמִ֣ין צָרָ֑יו הִ֝שְׂמַ֗חְתָּ כָּל אוֹיְבָֽיו

verses.restored: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

familiar.text: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

modern.text: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
